name: qa-grpc
description: gRPC testing tooling: buf-CLI lint and breaking-build (protobuf versioning catalog in its references), ghz load testing, grpcurl CLI, grpc-mock servers (interceptor test patterns in its references), and the single gRPC-streaming test home (status-code catalog + wire-level patterns in its references). Distinct from qa-contract-testing/protobuf-compat-checking (schema-level breaking detection); this plugin scopes to tooling, load, linting, and framework-level testing.
